shell_meta_description: Math concepts you can see, drag and understand.
catalog_intro: Concepts you can see, drag and understand.
catalog_empty_body: New concepts are on the way. Check back soon.
error_404_body: This page or step does not exist. Go back to the catalog.
error_scene_body: Something went wrong drawing this concept. Reload the page to try again.
uc_hook: Drag a point and see angles, cos and sin appear.
uc_step_intro_caption: A circle with radius 1. Drag the point around it.
uc_step_angle_caption: The angle θ measures how far the point has turned from the right.
uc_step_radian_caption: Lay the radius along the circle. That arc length is one radian.
uc_step_radians_caption: About {pi} radii fit on half a circle. That is π.
uc_step_cosine_caption: The shadow on the x-axis is cos θ.
uc_step_sine_caption: The shadow on the y-axis is sin θ. Drag and watch both.
